entries.08074d4e610b7368: In this business, Naikai Engineering Co., Ltd. undertakes the management and operation of the company's customer facilities and operates gift shops, and also operates hotels and restaurants using buildings owned by the company. Revenue is disclosed together as part of the Other category, and amounts for each business are not printed.
entries.6478c2adfd32ca31: This is a reportable segment in which the company builds and repairs ships, and the consolidated subsidiary Naikai Engineering Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells abrasive materials and repairs life rafts. The company carries out construction and repair work at two plants, the Setoda Plant and the Innoshima Plant. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥46,497 million.
entries.aa9db0c53bb6bed4: This is a category not included in the reportable segments, and it includes the Land-Based Business and the Service Business operated by the consolidated subsidiary Naikai Engineering Co., Ltd. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥518 million.
entries.acaea33afc742325: A shipbuilding company based in Onomichi, Hiroshima Prefecture, whose core is building and repairing ships, and which also carries out civil engineering and construction and hotel management.
entries.c1da33c78680aeb5: This business is carried out by Naikai Engineering Co., Ltd., which handles civil engineering and construction, and the new construction and repair of the company's facilities. Revenue is disclosed together as part of the Other category, and amounts for each business are not printed.
entries.ebc84f0584a47c7e: This business builds ocean-going vessels, such as general cargo ships and car carriers, and coastal vessels, such as ferries and roll-on/roll-off cargo ships (RORO ships). The company handles a wide variety of ship types, from medium-sized Panamax vessels to small ferries. Revenue is disclosed together as part of the Shipbuilding Business, and amounts for each category are not printed.
entries.f27df016a10dd7e8: This business carries out repairs and modifications of various types of ships. Drawing on technology and know-how gained through experience and track record, it carries out high-quality repairs. Revenue is disclosed together as part of the Shipbuilding Business, and amounts for each category are not printed.
